source_text: Critics from empirical and assimilationist viewpoints emphasize that FGM's harms—evidenced by the need for surgical reversals in New Zealand clinics and global studies linking it to increased maternal mortality—transcend cultural boundaries, demanding policy focus on integration and deterrence rather than equivocal "dialogue" that risks normalizing violence. [27]
